interpretation: Three independent data-independent random orthogonal projections from the full 9-dimensional per-channel 3x3 stencil to rank 5 all failed the frozen 45/45 gate. Together with Phase 18 PCA compression and Phase 19 transition-predictive compression, this indicates that the failure is not specific to a variance or predictiveness objective. At rank 5, removing four local spatial directions can destroy dynamics-critical information for wave, NLS, and advection even though Gray-Scott remains robust.
comparison_to_phase17: The uncompressed unnamed 3x3 stencil in Phase 17 passed all 45 registered cells. Phase 20 therefore brackets a real gap between rank 5 and rank 9 spatial operator coverage but does not yet locate the minimal sufficient rank.

claim_limit: Synthetic known-law systems only. Random rank-5 failure does not prove that no specially structured rank-5 basis can work, nor does it establish a universal lower bound. It motivates a preregistered paired rank sweep to locate the sufficiency threshold under data-independent projections.
